Credit: Worth Sharing app

After her F-15E Strike Eagle was mistakenly shot down in a friendly-fire incident, a female U.S. Air Force pilot ejected safely and descended into Kuwait. Uncertain of what awaited her on the ground, she landed in unfamiliar terrain.

What happened next https://t.co/J3JW5x8izS
post.author_description: Big fan of political skirmishes, college football, slow-cooked BBQ and lip gloss that stays on for more than 20 minutes. Feel free to follow @OKGretchen, too!

description.description: A social media style image featuring a female pilot in military flight gear smiling alongside three Middle Eastern men wearing white traditional kanduras and ghutras. All four individuals are smiling and giving thumbs-up or hand gestures. The image includes a text overlay at the bottom and a logo at the top left.
